proposal.text:
The corrected access policy now passes Codex’s actual parser, and the offline file-access checks passed. Full isolation is still unproven: already-open files and pipes remain usable, and macOS blocked the nested-sandbox test.

To get to your testable prototype, the next step is one five-minute native-chat test using your existing ChatGPT sign-in and Astra, automatic pairing, one sample message, then cleanup. The agent host still runs with your Mac user’s access. Approve that bounded test?
